note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: First print after close, and the company tends to raise its savings targets: at the first post-Skydance-merger print (10 Nov 2025) it raised the cost-savings target from $2B to $3B, gave its first FY guide, and the stock rose +9.8% (15.25 to 16.74) despite missing estimates; at Q2 2026 it raised run-rate efficiencies from $2.5B to $2.7B. The current public target is >=$6B run-rate synergies within three years, 3.0x net leverage by end-2029 and >$10B FCF in 2030 (6 Oct 2026 closing release). Debtwire's base case credits only $1.75B by 2027 and puts net leverage at 6.16x on realised synergies, so the market discounts the target heavily (stock below the $12 financing price). An early quantification or upsizing on this call lands against a sceptical bar.

findings.finding: Leverage is the bear line. S&P cut the rating to BB on projected ~7.6x leverage lasting into 2027. A combined-company FCF or transformation-cost frame weaker than the 3.0x-by-2029 path would hit the equity.
